name: valid-empty-review-plus-food-parent-veto-v1

policy.healthy_empty_pass: No identities, partials or multi intent; fully valid empty schema and successful normal provider. Return review without declaring a negative.
policy.food_parent_veto: Existing legacy autosave may only be downgraded when food evidence resolves exclusively to a nonfood parent category.
policy.other_paths: Unchanged baseline, including Deep review policy and multi-place handling.

evaluation.design: Paired common-prefix evaluation. Run the repaired baseline once on 62 heldout inputs; freeze all provider outputs. Apply both deterministic changes label-free to that immutable run, then freeze the candidate before either heldout score is opened.
evaluation.cost: Counterfactual retained measured request usage for calls that the candidate executes. Record actual experiment spending separately; do not claim replay is a new paid run.
evaluation.latency: Retain full baseline latency plus local policy overhead; credit no avoided downstream latency.
evaluation.thresholds: No fitted numeric threshold. Freeze this rule set now.
evaluation.safety: No newly wrong confident outputs, no lost correct autonomous resolutions or complete multi sets. Use 10000 connected-group bootstrap draws, seed 20261011, for cost per correct autonomous ratio.
evaluation.heldout_tuning: No changes after opening this heldout generation. Any failure requires a new development generation.

development_limits: One correct development review candidate is lost under the empty-stop rule; autonomous correct decisions are preserved.
Overall observed autonomous precision remains low; this is a prospective cost comparison, not a high-precision population claim.
Schema-enumeration combined candidate is rejected after four new wrong/incomplete multi-place saves.
